text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"The one who won... is a Japanese 
Umamusume...?!" "No way, to think she beat 
all three of them...!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone back in Japan, are you watching?! 
Witness the incredible feat <chrname> has achieved!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh, ...brilliantly... ngh, <chrname> did 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan from Japan
text_block_list.text: Congraaaats, <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—It is no dream. It is no illusion. Voices 
of blessing soar through France.

<chrname>'s outstretched hand reached the gate. As 
the world's strongest Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: 『<chrname>...』

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
"Making it impossible to forget you... 
That's just unfair..."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"Venus Park, it's okay to let your 
frustration out out loud."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...Master."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"Frustration becomes power. It turns into 
the fiery desire in your heart to win next 
time."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"Make everything useful serve as your 
fuel. Even I... feel frustrated, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...! ...Ngh. U-Uuuuugh...!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to win... so badly! I wanted 
to... I wanted to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. That's fine. Let's keep trying 
until we win."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: “This time, we're the challengers.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, Trainer <username>. You two still have 
a major task ahead of you."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The world is waiting for you all! They're 
asking you to hurry up and lift that 
trophy!

With Mei Satake pulling your arm, you head 
to the podium alongside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: You are so amazing!! Félicitations!

Even while on the move, people from 
various countries sang <chrname>'s praises. 
Applause was given, handshakes were 
requested—
Suddenly, she stopped.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Haha... My bad, my bad. You're the ones 
who worked hard, and yet here I am..."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Truly... it feels like I'm dreaming. To 
think I could be greeted by such a sight.
choice_data_list:
I was able to stand here because I kept 
dreaming

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Thank you, <chrname>, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just a little further to the podium. Go 
on, guide your prized Umamusume up there.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Go on, you two, and bask in the greatest 
blessing together.

—Exchanging glances with <chrname>, you take your 
next step forward together.

Step by step alongside her, treading upon 
the tiers of the podium—
<chrname> held up the trophy.

"...I shall follow suit. Feeling that 
weight firmly in the palm of my hand."
choice_data_list:
(The world's best, grasped together with 
you.)

(The world's best, grasped together with 
you.)

text_block_list.text:
Holding the romance she had always wished 
for close to her heart.

...—So that the people who wished for that 
sight can see the radiance of that trophy, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Grandfather Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Congratulations, <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Grandfather Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...So this is what the greatest view in 
the world looks like.
